mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with jointly increasing HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing above 2% by the 10-year Treasury yield (implied by FEDFUNDS and GDPC1) signals a shift towards monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with implied 10Y Treasury Yield above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 6%) with jointly increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a labor market at full capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of quarters within this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase above 2.5% YoY signals rising inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 58% of instances with CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY.
